headline: Demand Outlook positive, inflationary pressures a drag

highlights: Although, calibrated price actions are likely to partly offset the pressure; however, we expect YoY EBIDTA margin to decline in 3Q27 on a high base.
Consolidated Financials: volumes increased ~13%: Consolidated Revenues grew by 15.6% YoY to Rs56bn (PLe: Rs54.21bn).
Gross margins contracted by 203bps YoY to 39.6% (Ple: 41.5%).
EBITDA grew by 7% YoY to Rs10.2bn (PLe: Rs9.65bn); Margins contracted by 147bps YoY to 18.3% (PLe:17.8%).
watch: However, sustained RM cost inflation and the ability to maintain momentum in an inflationary environment remains key monitorable.
